generator_metadata.summary: Generate a fixed 3x3 multicolor input. Apply scale-map with row scales (2, 1, 2) and column scales (2, 1, 2): duplicate the top/bottom rows and left/right columns while leaving the middle row/column single. The result is 5x5. Every ordinary scene has distinct adjacent row and column signatures so the non-uniform scale is directly identifiable.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The row-expanded 3-column grid, together with its target-color count in each column.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Use the top-left cell as the target color and expand each source row by 10 exactly when that row contains the target at least twice; otherwise retain it once.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Count the target color in each column of the Step-A intermediate, choose the leftmost maximum, and expand that selected column by 28 while retaining the other columns once.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Row expansion changes the column counts consumed by Step B: this case changes the leftmost winner from source column 0 to intermediate column 1, so selecting before Step A expands the wrong column.
